description: F3 FMA-divergence PIN: a genuinely regular parametric float axis whose non-FMA reconstruction start+(step*pos) differs from a fused multiply-add by 1 ULP at pos=5. A correct (non-FMA/RNE/start+(step*pos)) writer stores it PARAMETRIC (expect_parametric=true); an FMA-contracting or wrong-operand-order writer computes 0x40dda52635cbf3d7 at pos 5, fails to reproduce coord[5]=0x40dda52635cbf3d8, and would MATERIALIZE instead -> store-decision mismatch (dedup split). Unlike vector 09 (start=0.0, where fma(step,pos,0)==step*pos so FMA and non-FMA agree), this fixture actually discriminates FMA because start!=0.
